reviews.text: This place is way overpriced, and some of the vets have very little knowledge. Seems geared to people with insurance only. Totally unaffordable for most of the area it serves.

I was able to book an online appointment easily. Reception staff were very friendly and I love how clean the place is. The vet (Alice I think was her name) was so wonderful with my cat. The wee one is doing much better now so I can't thank you guys enough!
Perfect service, friendly staff, We are very happy!

Took my dog here a few years ago to get 4 teeth out due to issues with his gums.  Was told they would call me if any further work needed done..... when I picked my dog up later on in afternoon I was told they removed 22 teeth ......

I was so angry and  would loved to have made that decision or ask for a second opinion before they did something so drastic.

I made a complaint and they said I didnt need to pay for the procedure but my dogs no longer welcome there ....
Dear Veselin Vachkov, Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate it!

Just wanted to compliment the care and professionalism of Dr Hannah in dealing with my dog over the past couple of days. He’d had some sort of reaction, suspected insect sting, so a very swollen face. As he was starting to cough and become distressed I later called and they fitted him in just before closing, despite this he received an excellent level of care. No improvement the next day and he seemed worse in himself so as instructed brought him in. The vet talked through a number of options should he not improve so I left feeling reassured. He’s back to his usual self today, had he worsened though I would have felt much better taking him back to such a proactive professional. Must commend the reception team in here as well, always pleasant and helpful.

Today was an incredibly hard day as we had to put down our beloved cat of almost 19 years. Hannah was kind and compassionate. We would have struggled without her empathetic, patient nature. She guided us through the process and didn't feel rushed. Thank you for your support, Hannah!
Great care was provided for our cat when he was poorly and unfortunately had to be euthanased

Lovely receptionists and great experience with the veterinarian who attended to Norman the chihuahua.

She provided all the essential checks and administered a couple of vaccines - all whilst having a very calm and gentle demeanour which definitely put Norman at ease during his appointment 😊

Thank you!
Dear Lomond Kitchens & Bathrooms, Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We appreciate it :-)

Dont take your pet here. These people just see pound signs. Extortionate prices for check ups which leads to more money as they will find something “wrong” with your beloved pet. Sometimes advice is all people need but they charge even for that. They DO NOT put the animal first b
Have used this vet for a number of years, lovely kind staff

Lovely helpful receptionist
Vet was great dealing with my feisty cat cookie thank you 3 mile vet xx

This vet practice refused to examine my now dead dog unless we paid £100+ for unneeded x-rays. The did not check him physically, and barely touched him. When we explained to them that we didn't have the money for tests, and just needed to see if he needed to be euthanised or not (spolier alert: he did). The vet then told us that because we couldn't afford testing that we could instead hand our sick 10 year old dog into their care, where he would be treated and then adopted out to someone else and we would never know if he was alive or not. We did not go with this option, and therefore did not receive any treatment. We then had to pay £68 for an appointment and examination that never happened. A week later our dog was still crying with pain and could no longer eat, so we took him to a different vet, who after a quick consultation, and a physical examination, told us that our dog was in incurable pain and had a severe heart murmur. Our only option was humane euthanasia, so we, with heavy hearts and wonderful memories, did just that. I will be forever thankful to that vet, who put my darling dog down, as i know that is what he needed. And i will forever resent 3 mile vets for their abhorrent behaviour and greed. Be warned that these vets will take advantage of your worried and grieving mind to make you pay for unnecessary tests and treatments that will only prolong your pet's pain. DO NOT go to this vets, please. They are dangerous and money hungry vultures.

Sorry to say after 14years of attending this vets with different animals l would not recommend their services.
Please your animal deserves only the best and this vets unfortunately can’t deliver that. Given good Customer service is unfortunately not in their business portfolio at this time. Which is a pity to both owners and the animal. Too many mistakes which leaves both owner and animal stressed. They lost a good customer and their animal.
Dear Bryan Kirk, Thank you for taking the time to leave a review.
